description:
A warehouse manager needs to know the monthly operating cost of a new 4200-watt industrial air compressor that runs 8 hours per day. Using the Electrical Engineering Calculations app, navigate to the Electricity Cost (or Energy Cost) calculator and compute the monthly cost with these parameters:

- Power consumption: 4200 Watts
- Hours of use per day: 8
- Number of days: 30
- Electricity rate: 0.14 $/kWh

After calculating, the result should show approximately 1008 kWh total energy and approximately $141.12 total cost.

Leave the result displayed on screen and save a screenshot of the result to /sdcard/task_result.png (using: screencap -p /sdcard/task_result.png).
